SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN ordered_at >= '2025-07-01' AND ordered_at < '2025-08-01' THEN product_price ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2025_07,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ordered_at >= '2025-08-01' AND ordered_at < '2025-09-01' THEN product_price ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2025_08,
  100.0 * (
    SUM(CASE WHEN ordered_at >= '2025-08-01' AND ordered_at < '2025-09-01' THEN product_price ELSE 0 END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN ordered_at >= '2025-07-01' AND ordered_at < '2025-08-01' THEN product_price ELSE 0 END)
  ) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN ordered_at >= '2025-07-01' AND ordered_at < '2025-08-01' THEN product_price ELSE 0 END), 0) AS revenue_growth_pct
FROM "jaffle_shop"."dev"."order_items"
WHERE ordered_at >= '2025-07-01' AND ordered_at < '2025-09-01'
